map.按血液撞击表面角度 α=arcsin(W/L)（W 短轴、L 长轴，单位 mm）: Using the impact angle α = arcsin(W/L) (W minor axis, L major axis, in mm), the smaller the ratio W/L the steeper the angle; combine the lines through multiple stains (the chord method) to trace back to the blood source and the spatter direction.
map.单枚喷溅血迹长轴 L=10 mm、短轴 W=6 mm：W/L=0.6，α=arc: For a single spatter stain with major axis L = 10 mm and minor axis W = 6 mm: W/L = 0.6, so α = arcsin(0.6) = 36.9°. This is a medium-angle spatter; combining the lines of adjacent stains roughly locates the blood source and indicates the direction of force.
